messages:
maria.lopez: FYI product is deprecating the v1 SDK next month. We need tiny, high-impact docs changes: a short migration guide, updated code snippets (chat, streaming, embeddings), a deprecation banner, and starter repo updates. Goal: merged PRs by 2026-04-15.

samir: Will SDK 2.x include a compatibility shim?

maria.lopez: Minimal shim for simple request/response calls (header and param mapping). No shim for streaming, function-calls, or structured outputs. Call that out explicitly.

kevin: Model remap table to include in the guide: redwood-small -> rw/small-1, redwood-chat -> rw/chat-1, redwood-embed -> rw/emb-large. Also note embeddings billing now counts per 768-dim chunk.

olivia: I'll draft an embeddings before/after snippet and a one-line note about dims->billing.

    // v1 embeddings (old)
    // client.embeddings({ model: 'redwood-embed', input: ['a', 'b'] })

    // v2 embeddings (new)
    // const resp = await rwClient.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw/emb-large', input: ['a', 'b'] })
    // console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length) // dims -> billing units

samir: Chat snippets need the call signature change and header rename (X-Client -> X-RW-Client). Also add a compat limitations callout.

    // v1 chat
    // client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', messages: [...] })

    // v2 chat
    // const chat = await rwClient.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rw/chat-1', input: { messages: [...] } })

taylor_w: I'll open one PR with TS/JS snippet swaps + short migration note and a streaming caveats section. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria.lopez: Tag me as reviewer and keep PRs small.

kevin: Note about rollout behavior: pinned-model-unavailable now returns 409 with header x-rw-fallback instead of silent routing. Add troubleshooting bullet and a tiny retry example.

olivia: I'll write the 409 troubleshooting note and push the retry snippet.

samir: Starter templates also need the CLI flag updates.

maria.lopez: Correct. Example CLI change:

    # v1
    rw-up --client v1 --model redwood-chat

    # v2
    rw-up --client v2 --model rw/chat-1

doc-bot: docs-bot: preview will run once PRs are open.

maria.lopez: Action items:
- taylor_w: PR for snippet swaps + header callout + migration note
- olivia: embeddings note + 409 troubleshooting bullet
- samir: compat-callout copy + limitations list
- kevin: model mapping table + fallback notice
- all: update starter examples

kevin: I'll push the mapping table to the branch.

taylor_w: Opening PR now, will ping reviewers.

maria.lopez: Once merged I'll update the deprecation banner and link to the migration guide. :thumbsup:
